name: Low-Poly 3D
visualIdentity: Explicitly defined by deliberately limited meshes, readable silhouettes, faceted shading, and selected color fields. Keep joints and contact credible; frame clearly and preserve recognizable forms.
suitableUses: Explicit examples: faceted characters and objects. Suggested hybrids suit travel, environment, game-world, geography, and site-planning explainers. Inferred: useful when clear, stylized 3D supports the message.
limitations: Avoid reducing polygons until subjects become unrecognizable, smoothing normals, mixed realistic textures, or depth and camera moves that harm projection, grounding, or readability. For data terrain, use verified values; state vertical exaggeration and keep facet geometry faithful to them.
palette: Optional suggestion for new artwork only: background #F1EBDF, foreground #34484C, accents #799C8C and #C28A68; four discrete colors, no gradient. Exact task, brand, reference, and semantic colors take precedence. Do not recolor subjects or assets. Accent/foreground contrast is insufficient for normal text; use the main background pairing and check actual composites.
motionAndInteraction: Use stable, authored 3D motion, clear camera framing, and credible contact. Optional patterns include miniature depth parallax, camera orbit or dolly, and progress-linked chapters or stories when geometry and narrative support them. Interactive HTML may map pointer or scroll to bounded, reversible movement, with keyboard/touch and reduced-motion alternatives where applicable. Video must derive state from seekable composition time, independent of live input.
audio: No fixed soundtrack is specified. Choose music, voice, effects, ambience, or silence for the topic and audience; honor supplied requirements and assets. Keep speech clear, avoid clipping, and synchronize audio with picture.
assetRequirements: Create faceted models, materials, lighting, animation, and renders in Blender, using its bundled Python API for procedural work; EEVEE is suggested for faster rendering, with Cycles also noted. Ensure enough geometry or captured views for orbit; parallax needs suitable depth layers and crop margins. Optional 2D triangulation supports planar geometry or height fields, not arbitrary 3D surfaces or boundary-aware meshing.
combinations: Style suggestions: miniature diorama for bounded travel or game scenes; terrain and spatial data for verified geographic values, with labels in a 2D layer and fixed color meanings. Keep facet density consistent, flat shading, and depth of field from hiding subjects. Motion patterns are optional and require scene-specific support.
productionApproach: Select Blender as style renderer and motion engine according to fidelity and action; keep each animated property to one owner. HyperFrames is the default composition, timing, synchronization, validation, and export pipeline; use Remotion only if unavailable or a verified limitation blocks a requirement, and record why. Build deterministic, seekable state or baked assets. For interactive HTML, add live input separately. Inspect representative frames and the complete video, including timing, audio, crop, and loop seams.
